/bin/zsh -lc 'tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ed4-live-XXXXXX); python3 - <<'"'PY' \""'$tmp"
import base64, os, sys
p=sys.argv[1]
with open(os.path.join(p,'"'master.key'),'w') as f: f.write(base64.b64encode(os.urandom(32)).decode()+'\\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(p,'master.key'),0o600)
PY
cat > \""'$tmp/config.yaml" <<EOF
server:
  listen_addr: ":7917"
  sqlite_path: "$tmp/ac.db"
  admin_socket_path: "$tmp/admin.sock"
web_console:
  enabled: true
  listen_addr: "127.0.0.1:7918"
secret_management:
  master_key_file: "$tmp/master.key"
blob_store:
  root: "$tmp/blobs"
EOF
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$tmp"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -euo pipefail
BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7918
for i in $(seq 1 80); do
  if curl -fsS "$BASE/api/health" >/tmp/ed4-health.json 2>/tmp/ed4-curl.err; then break; fi
  sleep 0.1
done
cat /tmp/ed4-health.json
printf '"'\\n--- version ---\\n'
curl -fsS \""'$BASE/api/version"
printf '"'\\n--- signup ---\\n'
curl -fsS -c /tmp/ed4-jar.txt -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST \""'$BASE/api/auth/signup" -d '"'{\"display_name\":\"alice\",\"passcode\":\"Acme-pass1"'!","organization_name":"Acme","email":"alice@example.test"}'"'
printf '\\n--- me ---\\n'
curl -fsS -b /tmp/ed4-jar.txt \""'$BASE/api/auth/me"
printf '"'\\n--- insight overview ---\\n'
curl -fsS -b /tmp/ed4-jar.txt \""'$BASE/api/orgs/acme/insights/overview?window=24h"
printf '"'\\n--- insight executions ---\\n'
curl -fsS -b /tmp/ed4-jar.txt \""'$BASE/api/orgs/acme/insights/executions?window=24h"'

/bin/zsh -lc "BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7918
printf '%s\\n' '--- signup ---'

printf '%s\\n' '--- insight executions ---'
curl -sS -i -b /tmp/ed4-jar.txt \""'$BASE/api/orgs/acme/insights/executions?window=24h" | sed -n '"'1,120p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- insight overview jq collections ---'
curl -sS -b /tmp/ed4-jar.txt \""'$BASE/api/orgs/acme/insights/overview?window=24h" | jq '"'{agents,projects}'
printf '%s\\n' '--- insight executions jq collections ---'
curl -sS -b /tmp/ed4-jar.txt \""'$BASE/api/orgs/acme/insights/executions?window=24h" | jq '"'{executions}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7918
SLUG=org-32dbc2b5
